blocked_until_later_phases: Complex JobFitAlignment training must wait for a materialized balanced pair dataset with high-fit validation/test coverage.
Promotion must wait for human validation labels or equivalent trusted validation evidence.
Production score semantics must wait for Phase 10 calibration.
Ranking-objective promotion must wait for backend-like candidate sets and relevance labels.

experiment_matrix.label_source: Phase 2 job-fit score; weak labels allowed only as prototype evidence.
experiment_matrix.objective: Regression on transparent normalized scalar features.
experiment_matrix.promotion_gate: Must remain in report as a minimum floor for all complex scorers.

experiment_matrix.label_source: Same split and labels as complex scorers.
experiment_matrix.objective: Regression/ranking using only profile-CV and job text embedding cosine similarity.
experiment_matrix.promotion_gate: Complex models must beat this baseline on regression and ranking metrics.

experiment_matrix.label_source: Balanced Phase 4/next pair artifact with low/medium/high coverage and group-safe splits.
experiment_matrix.objective: Learn non-linear interactions between profile-CV embedding and job embedding for score prediction.
experiment_matrix.promotion_gate: Eligible only after it beats best baseline and passes slice stability gates.

experiment_matrix.label_source: Balanced pair labels plus manual validation labels when available.
experiment_matrix.objective: Combine embedding interactions with normalized skill, experience, role, language, and requirement coverage features.
experiment_matrix.promotion_gate: Primary candidate if it clears global, ranking, and slice gates without unsupported signals.

experiment_matrix.label_source: Backend-like candidate sets with relevance labels or manual ranking review.
experiment_matrix.objective: Optimize ordering among backend-provided candidate jobs for each profile/CV context.
experiment_matrix.promotion_gate: Cannot replace score model unless candidate-set constraints and ranking uplift pass.

input_feature_contract.leakage_rule: must not include target score, public API summary, manual validation note, or backend product copy
input_feature_contract.missing_policy: fail training row if both profile and CV text are empty; otherwise record source_text_coverage
input_feature_contract.range_or_shape: embedding_dim from embedding_model_version; L2-normalized before cosine features
input_feature_contract.source_evidence: profile text plus parsed CV text when available
input_feature_contract.validation_check: embedding exists, finite values only, embedding_model_version recorded

input_feature_contract.leakage_rule: must not include backend hydration fields unavailable to model core at inference
input_feature_contract.missing_policy: fail row if job text is empty; keep stale/inactive job filtering outside model training unless source snapshot labels it
input_feature_contract.range_or_shape: same dimension and model version as profile_cv_embedding
input_feature_contract.source_evidence: job title, role, required skills, requirements, and description text

input_feature_contract.leakage_rule: skill aliases must come from versioned dictionary, not validation labels
input_feature_contract.missing_policy: empty skill lists produce 0.0 plus empty_skills flags
input_feature_contract.source_evidence: Phase 3 normalized profile/CV skills and job skills
input_feature_contract.validation_check: all raw skills normalized with alias version and unknown-skill count reported

input_feature_contract.leakage_rule: must not infer seniority from target label or output score
input_feature_contract.missing_policy: UNKNOWN experience gets explicit missing indicator and conservative gap feature
input_feature_contract.range_or_shape: candidate years minus required years; clipped diagnostic buckets allowed for model input
input_feature_contract.validation_check: no observed Phase 3 experience value falls through silently

input_feature_contract.leakage_rule: must not use job recommendation rank or backend search position
input_feature_contract.missing_policy: missing profile role becomes UNKNOWN role family and score 0.0 unless CV role evidence exists
input_feature_contract.source_evidence: normalized profile target role, CV role evidence, job title, and job role family

input_feature_contract.leakage_rule: manual reviewer comments must never become coverage features
input_feature_contract.missing_policy: empty job requirements produce null coverage and missing_requirement flag, not 1.0
input_feature_contract.source_evidence: job requirements matched against profile/CV skills, tools, education, experience, and evidence text
input_feature_contract.validation_check: coverage denominator and unmatched requirement count recorded

input_feature_contract.leakage_rule: IDs may be used for grouping/audit only, never as predictive model features
input_feature_contract.missing_policy: training blocked if split, pair_type, label_version, or score_band is missing
input_feature_contract.range_or_shape: pair_type, split, profile_id, job_id, language, score_band, label_version
input_feature_contract.validation_check: profile_id is isolated across splits and high-fit coverage exists in validation/test

model_owned_fields.grounding_rule: Derived from calibrated job-fit model output only; no wrapper sentiment or backend ranking position.
Only observed alignment evidence such as role_match, strong_skill_overlap, experience_match, and requirement_coverage.
Only observed gaps such as missing_required_skill, experience_gap, low_requirement_coverage, or unknown_language.
Intersection of normalized candidate skills and job skills/requirements with source evidence.
Required job skills not found in normalized profile/CV evidence.
Data-quality and model-confidence notes such as low_text_coverage, unknown_experience, unknown_language, or out_of_distribution_role.

public_api_mapping.jobFitAlignment.score: core.score rounded/clipped to integer 0-100 after Phase 10 calibration
public_api_mapping.jobFitAlignment.summary: API wrapper renders from summarySignals, missingSignals, confidenceNotes, matchedSkills, and missingSkills

contract_safety_gates.boundary: model output must not include topActionables, sectionReviews, hydrated job details, auth, or persistence fields
contract_safety_gates.calibration_dependency: Phase 10 calibration required before production score semantics are claimed
contract_safety_gates.grounding: matchedSkills and missingSkills must appear in normalized source evidence
